title: Sina Score as a New Machine Learning-Derived Online Prediction Model of Mortality for Cirrhotic Patients Awaiting Liver Transplantation: A Prospective Cohort Study.
summary: Learned SINA mortality score evaluated prospectively in cirrhosis transplant-waitlist cohort and compared with MELD. Results evaluates three-month mortality discrimination/calibration against observed outcomes; prospective cohort, no causal claim.
